name: LiNKskills
description: Private Skills adapter for Lisa: structured telemetry outbox against Skills Gateway contracts. Default-disabled; never registers conversation hooks; fake-only until activation gates.

mcpDiscoveryRead.label: Skills MCP Discovery/Read
mcpDiscoveryRead.help: When false, no Skills discovery/retrieval tools are exposed; native OpenClaw skills continue.

governedExecution.label: Governed Execution
governedExecution.help: When false, block LiNKskills execution only; native skills continue.

telemetryEnqueue.label: Telemetry Enqueue
telemetryEnqueue.help: When false, no new Skills telemetry records are accepted; existing outbox is retained.

telemetryDrain.label: Telemetry Drain
telemetryDrain.help: When false, stop Skills delivery; local durable queue is retained.

skillsCredential.label: Skills Credential
skillsCredential.help: SecretRef or string for the Skills-only credential. Never paste live secrets into source.

machineToken.label: Machine Token Binding
machineToken.help: Optional client_credentials + private_key_jwt binding. When set, HTTP uses machine-token instead of skillsCredential. clientAssertionKeyRef must be a SecretRef object (no literal PEM/JWK/env/CLI strings). bindingId must not equal Brain bindingId. issuerUrl and endpoints require HTTPS outside explicit local-test loopback. For Tailscale/CGNAT/private-overlay HTTPS issuers set allowPrivateNetwork=true (default false); never use environment=test for stage/production.

redactionPolicyVersion.label: Redaction Policy Version
redactionPolicyVersion.help: Allowlist policy version applied to structured telemetry envelopes before remote writes.

outboxMaxEntries.label: Outbox Max Entries
outboxMaxEntries.help: Per-namespace keyed-store capacity with reject-new overflow.

transportMode.label: Transport Mode
transportMode.help: disabled (default), fake (test-only), mcp (managed mcp.servers entry), or http (Gateway HTTPS base skillsEndpoint + /v1/{operation}).

mcpServerName.label: MCP Server Name
mcpServerName.help: Key under mcp.servers for Skills managed MCP. Default linkskills.

skillsEndpoint.label: Skills Endpoint
skillsEndpoint.help: LiNKskills Gateway HTTPS base URL for transportMode=http. Requests POST /v1/{allowlisted skills_* operation} with {params,idempotency_key,request_id}.

allowProductionLoopbackHttp.label: Production Loopback HTTP
allowProductionLoopbackHttp.help: Permit only a same-machine localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 HTTP Skills endpoint in production. This does not permit LAN, VPC, Tailscale, or public HTTP.

allowPrivateNetwork.description: Explicit least-privilege opt-in for HTTPS private/CGNAT/Tailscale issuers. Default false. Pins the configured issuer origin/hostname under SSRF; does not enable localTest and does not broadly disable SSRF. Metadata/link-local remain blocked.

skillsEndpoint.description: LiNKskills Gateway HTTPS base for transportMode=http (POST /v1/{operation}; SecretRef or machineToken bearer).

allowProductionLoopbackHttp.description: Explicitly permit HTTP only to same-machine loopback for a co-located production Skills Gateway.
